_help: Phase 16 part kits. Each kit is a pair of sheets (front and back) on a magenta background, kept in tools/art-source/part-kit so they never ship: six animals as columns, one row per kind, then a row of extras. Drop a sheet on the Studio (Art workbench, Sheet mode) to slice it; part ids are <animal>_<row> and <kit>_<extra>, so adding a kit never renames old parts. kits: each kit's animals, rows and extras (and its slicing settings, slice). slots: the slot each kind fills. pivots: each kind's turning point. sockets: where parts connect, given by hand per part and view (fractions of the picture, x right, y down); the workbench works out a torso's neck, shoulders, hips and tail from its outline and a limb's joint from its top rows, and these replace what it works out (the back views of the kit are drawn mirrored). parts: what the workbench made.
